title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
description:
S1 E1 — Barbershop 2: Back in Business (2004)
The Barbershop is threatened by the arrival of a hip, well-financed chain barbershop that's about to open next door.

title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
description:
S1 E1
It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
description:
S1 E1
Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

title: Beyond The Lights
description:
S1 E1
The pressures of fame have superstar singer Noni on the edge until she meets Kaz, a young cop who works to help her find the courage to develop her own voice and break free to become the artist she was meant to be.

title: Save The Last Dance
description:
S1 E1
Sara is a small-town girl who dreams to become a world-class ballerina. But when her mother suddenly dies, she must abandon her plans and join her estranged father on Chicago's South Side.

title: Lila & Eve
description:
S1 E1
Lila, a grief-stricken mother reeling from her son's murder, attends a support group where she meets Eve, who urges her to take matters into her own hands to track down her son's killers. They soon embark on a journey of revenge, but also recovery.

title: Out Of Sync
description:
S1 E1
After he is released from prison, a former DJ tries to go straight and put his various vices behind him.

title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka (1988)
description:
S1 E1
This ultra-hip Comedy in the tradition of The Naked Gun and Airplane stars Keenan Ivory Wayans in an Action Adventure filled with screwball gags and side-splitting one-liners.

title: Boomerang
description:
S1 E1
Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor, Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!
